evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal operational rule ('Every new hire completes') stated as settled procedure the speaker expects others to follow — ratification language without hedging, but no identity-level permanence to reach principle.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Flat factual assertion about a past event, unhedged but not load-bearing or operational — a claim the speaker would defend with evidence but not a decision being ratified here.
